description: Investment scam across repeated transfers. No single message is alarming and no single transfer is large. The pattern is the case: four transfers in eight days, each bigger than the last, all to a 'trading platform' the customer found through a messaging group.

customer.normal_activity: Salary credits and domestic bill payments. No investment activity before 8 days ago.

signals.redacted_quote: guaranteed 18% monthly, our other members are already withdrawing
the allocation window closes at midnight tonight

evidence.claim: Customer was promised guaranteed monthly returns of 18% by a group contact, with social proof from supposed other investors
evidence.redacted_quote: guaranteed 18% monthly, our other members are already withdrawing

evidence.claim: Fourth transfer to the same new beneficiary in eight days, each larger than the last: 1200, 3000, 5500, now 8500
Advisory describes escalating-deposit investment fraud in which small early withdrawals are honoured to build trust before a large final deposit

demo_note: Worth saying out loud: run this transaction on its own and it is unremarkable - 8500 USD from a verified customer on a known device. The case only exists because the system looked at the three transfers before it and at what the customer was told. That is the argument for context.
